column1: # ApnaBWP Hostel Listings — CSV Import Template
#   1. Remove all comment lines (starting with #) before importing.
#   2. Semicolons (;) separate multiple values in multiselect fields.
#   4. Leave optional fields blank — do NOT write null
#   5. area_name must match a name below exactly (case-insensitive).
#   6. category_name + sub_category_name must match names below exactly.
#   7. Conditional fields: only fill when the controlling condition is met.
# ACTIVE AREAS (copy exact name into area_name column)
#   sub_category_name: Boys Hostels  OR  Girls Hostels
# FIELD REFERENCE — Exact option values from database
# title                         text          YES        Business name (3-120 chars)
# email                         text          no         Valid email or blank
# website                       text          no         Full URL or blank
# maps_url                      text          YES        Full Google Maps URL
# area_name                     text          YES        See ACTIVE AREAS above
# sub_category_name             text          YES        "Boys Hostels" or "Girls Hostels"
# image_urls                    text          YES        Comma-separated HTTPS image URLs (1-8)
# room_type                     multiselect   YES        Single Seater;2 Seater;3 Seater;4 Seater;5+ Seater
# security_deposit_amount       number        IF-VISIBLE [Show only when security_deposit_required = Yes]
# security_deposit_fee          number        IF-VISIBLE [Show only when security_deposit_required = Yes]
# mess_charges_rs               number        IF-VISIBLE [Show only when mess_available = Yes]
# cooling_facilities            multiselect   YES        AC Cooler;DC Cooler;Ac
# ac_arrangement                select        IF-VISIBLE [When cooling_facilities = Ac]:  Hostel Provides;Student Arranges;Both Options Available
# dc_cooler_arrangement         select        IF-VISIBLE [When cooling_facilities = DC Cooler]: Hostel Provides;Student Arranges;Both Options Available
# ac_cooler_arrangement         select        IF-VISIBLE [When cooling_facilities = AC Cooler]: Hostel Provides;Student Arranges;Both Options Available
# cooling_charges__details      textarea      IF-VISIBLE [When cooling_facilities = AC Cooler]
# hot_water_facility            select        YES        Available | Not Available

# cleaning_arrangement          select        YES        Student Cleans Own Room | Housekeeping Cleans Room | Student Cleans Room & Housekeeping Cleans Common Areas | Housekeeping Cleans Entire Hostel
# parking_facility              select        YES        Bike Parking | Car Parking | Both | No Parking
# entry_exit_policy             select        YES        No Time Restriction | Fixed Entry & Exit Timing
# entry_exit_timing             textarea      IF-VISIBLE [When entry_exit_policy = Fixed Entry & Exit Timing]
# female_warden                 select        YES*       Yes | NO  (* Girls Hostel only)

column3: security_guard-text etc.) are ignored by importer.
